title: Month index (v1/live/month.json)
description: The month under the live week: the M >= 2.5 events all_month carries, one compact file per UTC day from the day of now - 30 d through today - newest_offset_days, each with a sha256 fingerprint. APIs.md, Month index.

head_seq.description: the knowledge clock every day file of this run reflects

min_mag.description: the magnitude floor of every day file (all_month's)

window_days.description: the month window the days cover (all_month's 30 x 24 h)

newest_offset_days.description: the newest day is the run's UTC day minus this many days

features_format.description: the compact feature serialization of the day files (the live index's); a client holding the days in another one re-reads every day
